svg.title: Two NumPy reshapes for scikit-learn inputs
svg.desc: Two executed array layouts. A three-by-one array stores three parcel counts as many samples with one feature. A one-by-three array stores one sorting batch with parcel count, staff count, and belt speed as three features.
